title: The Bench Total Answered For and the Allowance for Work Still to Come
content:
# Costing Note: The Bench Total Answered For and the Allowance for Work Still to Come

This note defines the ceiling a customer agrees for work already at the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, and works it to a figure.

## The quantities

**The bench total the customer is answering for.** Every bench labour line standing priced on the work order, less every amount already taken off it, less everything a protection claim has answered for on it.

**The allowance rate.** The narrow contingency rate, 6 percent, with no further step added to it.

**The allowance for the work still to come.** That bench total taken at the allowance rate and rounded to the nearest cent. The allowance is taken as it stands. Whatever multiple the allowance is taken at, the figure it comes to is rounded to the nearest cent before it is added to the bench total.

**The time the piece has been at the bench.** Counted in calendar days from the day it was taken in over the counter.

## The ceiling

The ceiling a customer agrees for work already at the bench is worked out on the bench total they are answering for together with the allowance for the work still to come. The ceiling is the bench total the customer is answering for plus the allowance, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked to a figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a hypothetical work order showing 1,480.00 USD of bench labour lines, 130.00 USD already taken off it, and 350.00 USD answered for by a protection claim.

- The bench total the customer is answering for is 1,480.00 USD less 130.00 USD less 350.00 USD, that is 1,000.00 USD.
- The allowance is that bench total taken at the allowance rate of 6 percent, 60.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent, and it is taken as it stands.
- The figure the allowance comes to is rounded to the nearest cent before it is added to the bench total, and stands at 60.00 USD.
- The ceiling is 1,000.00 USD together with that allowance of 60.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent: 1,060.00 USD.

Had the same order carried nothing taken off it and nothing answered for by a claim, the bench total answered for would have been 1,480.00 USD, the allowance 88.80 USD, and the ceiling 1,568.80 USD.
